name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia Bellini's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood summers spent near the Imola circuit. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Bologna, she began her career in Formula 3, quickly making a name for herself with her meticulous approach to data analysis and problem-solving. Her expertise soon led to her recruitment into Formula 1 as a simulator engineer.

Alessia thrives on the challenge of translating real-world track data into accurate and insightful simulations. She is known for her ability to quickly identify and address subtle discrepancies between the virtual and actual car performance, allowing drivers to optimize their setups and improve lap times. While she is a dedicated team player, Alessia values independent work and is known for her ability to deliver exceptional results when given the autonomy to explore innovative solutions. Her dedication and keen eye for detail make her a valuable asset to the Stake Sauber team.

Alessia's experience at smaller teams early in her career taught her to be resourceful and adaptable, qualities she brings to Stake Sauber. She always has a solution, even when resources are tight.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Alessia is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn schematics.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to work late into the night when the simulator lab is quiet.
